episode_summary: Live from the Lund Comedy Festival, the hosts share facts about Lund University’s unfortunate meaning in several Indian languages, a ’90s fashion designer who now works as a toad facilitator, the Icelandic tradition of bringing a sheep into the bedroom for warmth, and extreme candies including a real recall of “Toxic Waste Nuclear Sludge.” The show features onstage taste-tests, housing history, and psychedelic toad lore.

facts.fact: My fact this week is that in many Indian languages, Lund University means penis university.
My fact this week is that one of the biggest fashion designers of the '90s now works as a toad facilitator.
My fact is, traditionally, the people of Iceland liked to bring a sheep into the bedroom.
Okay, my fact this week is that in 2011, a candy bar called Toxic Waste Nuclear Sludge was recalled for containing actual Toxic Waste.
